title: fix(app-shell): Studio's publish review sheet says a customization lives in this environment's database and moves only by `os package export`
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgJoNqzsoiqe3Hb6Lgi2XQ2n)_

domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 发布前的「待发布的变更」面板，在「保存到 X 的定制」下面加一行：这些变更保存在当前环境的数据库里，是 `BASE.custom` 的条目（写的是服务端给的真实包 id），不在项目源码中；只有通过 `os package export` 才能带到其他环境（十种语言，命令原样不翻译）。
- 为什么改：开发者在 `os dev` 的 Studio 里调好视图，`os build` 部署后改动不见了，Studio 从没说过它只在这个库里（ADR-0146 D2）。CLI 和脚手架那一半已由 PR #30336 落地，这是 Studio 这一半。
- 风险与回滚：只在面板审阅只读包的定制（host 传了 customizationOf）时多一行文字，其他面板和可写包一字不变；回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/savedToCustomization.tsx 的 customizationEnvironmentText；ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx 的 draft-changes-environment 那一行；ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts 的 customizationEnvironment。
- 两分钟验证：examples/app-showcase 跑 `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`，在 Studio 定制一个 Showcase 视图后点「变更」，面板标题下应看到「保存到 ObjectStack Showcase 的定制」和新的一行，点名 com.example.showcase.custom 与 os package export。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #30119

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

The card's first Expected bullet: "Studio says plainly, where a customization is saved, that it lives in this environment's database and how it moves." Triage 6652867871 states the done line: a Studio notice that a customization lives in this environment as an item of `BASE.custom` and travels only by `os package export`. The server half (CLI `os build` notice, scaffold README and AGENTS.md) landed in PR #30336.

- **Where.** The one sentence that already names where a customization is saved, "Saved to BASE's customizations" (`preview/savedToCustomization.tsx`, ADR-0146 D3), is drawn in two places: the pending-changes sheet (`DraftChangesPanel`) and the Studio item header's note line. The new line sits under it in the **sheet**, once per surface, not on a save toast. The sheet is where a person reviews the pair's drafts before they go live, and every pillar opens the same sheet.
- **The real package id.** The host passes `customizationOf` only while it reviews a pair's drafts, and then its `packageId` is the pair: the ensure door's answer or the listed pair the server serves (`StudioDesignSurface`'s `draftScope`). The sheet names that id. It computes no `.custom` spelling.
- **The command.** `os package export` is the constant `PACKAGE_EXPORT_COMMAND`, passed into every pack as `{{command}}`, so no translation can change it.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`:** `preview.changes.customizationEnvironment` in all ten packs (`{{pair}}`, `{{command}}`).
- **Not switched by environment.** The console can tell: `/api/v1/discovery` serves `environment` (`production` / `sandbox` / `development`, from `NODE_ENV`; measured `"development"` under `objectstack dev`). The line is shown everywhere anyway, because it is true everywhere: a customization made in production also lives only in that environment's database and reaches staging or a new environment only by export. Gating it on `development` would hide a true statement where it still applies.

## Tests

Head `8fc8d012` (after one merge of `origin/main`, which brought PR #30361's change to the same file in cleanly).

- `DraftChangesPanel.test.tsx`, in the existing "names the base whose customizations it saves" describe, through the real i18next hook and shipped packs: the line names `this environment's database`, `com.hotcrm.custom` and `os package export` in en, keeps the pair id and the command untranslated in zh, and the control (a writable package's own drafts) draws neither sentence. A new `it.each` over all ten packs: `customizationEnvironmentText` names the pair once and `PACKAGE_EXPORT_COMMAND` once, with no `{{` left.
- Ablation, one leg: the render condition mutated to `false && …` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed): exactly the two new render tests fail, 26 pass; restored, blob identical to `HEAD`.

## Acceptance notes

- The Studio item header's note line also says "Saved to BASE's customizations" (four call sites, all in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, which PR #30381 holds). It passes only the base's label, so naming the pair there needs that file. Left out; the seat files it as a follow-up after #30381.
- Surface widened by the seat (thread ruling 10:22Z): `preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, `preview/savedToCustomization.tsx` and their test, outside the Claim's `studio-design/**`.

## Verification

Live walk: `examples/app-showcase`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 4730`, console on Vite against it, signed in as the seeded admin. `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` answered 201 with `packageId: com.example.showcase.custom`; a draft of view `showcase_task.in_progress` was saved into the pair with `overrides: { package: com.example.showcase, basedOn: 0.1.0 }`; then `/studio/com.example.showcase/interfaces?changes=review`.

| Locale | Before (sources at `d3f23d20`) | After (this branch) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| zh-CN | 保存到 ObjectStack Showcase 的定制 (nothing else) | 保存到 ObjectStack Showcase 的定制 · 这些变更保存在当前环境的数据库里，是 com.example.showcase.custom 的条目，不在项目源码中；只有通过 os package export 才能带到其他环境。 |
| en | Saved to ObjectStack Showcase’s customizations (nothing else) | Saved to ObjectStack Showcase’s customizations · These changes are kept in this environment’s database as items of com.example.showcase.custom, not in your project’s source. They reach another environment only through os package export. |

The before leg is the same boot and the same draft, with the two `preview/` files checked out at `d3f23d20` (Vite reloaded them; restored afterwards, `git diff HEAD` empty).
